description:

The dealership said it might be the ESP module needing replaced, but we never did that because it didn't bother us to just restart it every once in awhile.
There's some electrical issue that seems to drain the battery if it sits too long, but we don't know how long that is because we don't use it very often anymore.

description:
Open House - Sat. 16 May, 11:00 - 2:00.  Modern Elegance in Pelican Bay! This beautifully maintained 3,670 sq ft rambler offers an ideal blend of comfort, style, and functionality in a highly desirable location. Built in 2017, the main level features a stunning great room with soaring vaulted ceilings, 3 spacious bedrooms, and 2 bathrooms, including a private primary suite with walk-in closet and separate tub and shower. The fully finished basement adds incredible flexibility-perfect for entertaining or multi-generational living. Enjoy a dedicated theater room with included screen, projector, speakers, and receiver, along with 2 additional bedrooms (one currently used as a recording studio), a stylish bathroom with walk-in shower, convenient cold storage, and plumbing already in place for a future kitchen. Additional highlights include a water softener and whole-home filtration system. Solar panels and batteries are excluded from the sale. Located in the Alpine School District, 1 block from Harbor Point Elementary, this home also includes access to outstanding community amenities such as parks, playgrounds, sports courts, picnic areas, and scenic waterfront walking trails-all for a low annual fee. Walking distance to the Saratoga Springs Marina and a newly completed park, this location is perfect for enjoying an active, outdoor lifestyle. title: 2017 Mini Yet Mighty Campervan only 90k miles!
description:
📍 Location: Salt Lake City, Utah
💲 Price: $17,800

Clean title — mileage 90,100 miles — 2017 Nissan Quest SV

*Brand new CVT transmission (these are the main concern when buying a used Nissan with this transmission). 
*Brand new brakes and rotors. 
*Brand new exterior paint (truck bed liner for heavy duty and an aggressive look).

No engine issues, no leaks, vehicle has been regularly maintained and runs great. Tires good 👍 both batteries good 👍 no problems with any campervan features.

Key Features
 • Full-size bed with storage underneath – easy pull-out design, quick setup.
 • 2 USB charging ports
 • Hidden safe to keep valuables secure.
 • Sink with electric water pump
 • 2-burner propane stove – compact, reliable, and easy to use.
 • 18L refrigerator (can double as a cooler with ice if off-grid for several days).
 • Secondary battery system powers the fridge, kitchen light, faucet, and 2 USB charging ports — charged while you drive. No solar worries, but the system can easily be upgraded with panels if you want more off-grid time.
 • Durable, easy-clean flooring — sweep and wipe down, no carpet to trap dirt or require a vacuum.
 • Privacy curtains 
 • 3 insect screens
 • Thule roof cargo box 
 • Space for a portable toilet if desired.

We’ve rented out vans like this for over five years and learned what really works for travelers. Everything in this van has been tested by real people on real trips—because when guests took our vans into the wild, we had to make sure it could handle the adventure without us there to fix it.

We purposely kept the design easy to operate. No toilet or outdoor shower curtain to confuse renters or cause maintenance issues, but still highly functional for travel. For those living in it, a few small additions can make it fully self-sufficient.

⭐️  Great fuel efficiency compared to larger vans.
⭐️ Everything you need is already on board— just pack your clothes and hit the road.
⭐️ Minimal setup time—you can pull over, extend the bed, and be resting in minutes.
⭐️ Worried about not being able to stand up? You’ll be surprised how nice it is to simply get in, get out, and park anywhere without the hassle of maneuvering a tall RV.

Honestly, photos don’t do this van justice. The space feels bigger than it looks, and you won’t really appreciate the layout until you’re inside. If you’re unsure, come take a look in person or we can FaceTime you for a tour.

title: Skoolie - 35' Thomas International
description:
HERE IS THE STORY! 
This bus is for a short family (no roof raise) of 4 that values off-grid living. 

What you are NOT getting:
- Good wood work
- Pretty cladding 

What you ARE getting:
- Fantastic electrical work
- A functionally organized space
- A bus designed to be off-grid with a family of 4

Is the wood working crap? YES! 
But why, Maryam? 
Well because….
The interior is 80% repurposed wood! That was important to us:
(1) Because we love the process of taking “trash” and making it useful, and 
(2) Because the money we saved went into the Victron system. Having a huge battery bank was more important to us than what it looked like. I know some will say you can have both, but we also finished this bus (with a little help) in under a year! We wanted to get going. *zoom*

- The ceiling is all pallet wood, painstakingly torn apart, planed and placed. 
- The vinyl flooring was left over from a housing remodel of my brother-in-law. 
- All the walnut wood trim, counter tops and dinning table came from scraps from a manufacturer who builds custom boxes for an ocular company.
- The cushion fabric was from old sunbrella scraps a friend gave to us when I was learning how to sew! 

It’s ALIVE! It’s ALIVE! 

HERE ARE THE DETAILS! 

Price is negotiable! Stop by and see Hector...then make an offer!

description:
I build standard and art sound panels for recording studios/spaces, home theaters, offices, bedrooms and homes with fengshui in mind.

I just finished a set of 3 of the quilt panel pictured.: they are really cool, they remind me of Saved by The Bell and 90’s-80’s in general.

-2x4 standard panels (any color): $69 each.
-2.5x6 standard panels (any color) $89 each. 
-2x4 vintage art panels (as available) $109 each.
- Custom sizes available upon request. $49-$169

I build sound panels using mostly up-cycled, materials. I have plain colored fabrics as well as more artistic pieces made with rare vintage materials and carpets that look really cool, especially if you want them in your room or home to dampen the sound but don’t want it to just look like a movie theater or recording studio. 

I will be continuously posting the one of a kind, vintage/art panels as they are available. 
Right now there are 2 panels available in black vintage, checkered velvet and satin. They are 2x4 They also look great paired with black or any other solid color of fabric.

I make 4 different kinds of panels all for each having their own purpose for effective sound treatment of a particular space by dampening echos and reverb, and absorbing sound waves into the panels

1. Wall panels
2. Ceiling Panels or “cloud panels”
3. Bass traps for the corners of a room.
4. Bogo panels (panels that act as a sort of room divider on caster wheels to easily move around if needed. Often used to isolate drums or vocals, as well as divide an open room into separate spaces

Materials: Gypsum board panels, dense acoustic foam, acoustic wool, framed with pine wood slats. (Sometimes other types of wood will be used for frames on custom orders.) They are wrapped in various types of materials. 
They create a great combination of sound absorbing and dispersing sound evenly throughout the room.

I can deliver for $25 in the SLC area.

title: Metal Panels
description:
Supply & Install

Why 24-Gauge Metal Flush Panels Are a Great Choice

Think of it like this:
24-gauge metal panels are the thicker, stronger version of metal siding. That extra thickness makes a big difference in how they look and how long they last.
 • Stronger & more dent-resistant
They’re much less likely to dent from hail, ladders, or everyday bumps.
 • Holds its shape better
Thicker metal stays flatter, so you don’t see ripples or waviness over time.
 • Handles weather extremely well
Wind, rain, snow, and temperature changes won’t affect it like other materials.
 • Fire-safe material
Metal doesn’t burn, which adds an extra level of safety to your home.
 • Very low maintenance
No rotting, cracking, or repainting every few years. Just occasional cleaning.
 • Modern, clean appearance
The panels give your home a smooth, high-end look that stays sharp for decades.
 • Long lifespan
This is not a “replace it later” product — it’s designed to last 40–60+ years.

title: Boxvana 2022 mobile Tiny Home
description:
This 2022 Boxvana mobile tiny home is officially designated as a PMRV (Park Model Recreational Vehicle). It’s a great option for a ready‑to‑go ADU or mother‑in‑law apartment. It requires grid power but includes solar panels for supplemental energy.

The home measures 34 feet long by 11 feet 8 inches wide, giving a footprint of about 400 square feet. The loft adds roughly 215 square feet, providing extra sleeping or storage space. Built with LitePan insulated panels for the floors, walls, and ceiling, it’s solid, energy‑efficient, and well‑insulated.

Inside, you’ll find one bedroom, one bathroom, a loft, kitchen, and living room. It comes equipped with a washer, dryer, oven, and microwave. Heating and cooling are handled by a mini‑split system, and the water heaters are installed underneath. Plumbing is ready for hookup to a septic or sewer system. It has heated floors but they need to be fixed.

The home weighs 18,000 pounds and sits on four axles with a bumper‑pull. It’s been on blocks for the past four years and will need to be transported by the buyer. Lightly lived in for only a couple of years, it’s clean, comfortable, and ready for its next chapter.

title: 2001 Scamp 13 foot (renovated)
description:
I renovated this awesome trailer last summer and lived in it for a few months. I'm not in a rush to sell it and I'm firm on the price, so I will call you mean names if you low ball me.
~
I worked on this trailer planning to use it for many years, but sadly my needs have changed and I’m moving to a setup with more space. It’s an incredible trailer and you need to come sit in it to appreciate the work that’s been done. This trailer is ready for off-grid camping or campground stays.
~
This camper sleeps 3 total; 2 in the back area where the dinette converts to a bed, and one on the front couch. The front no longer converts to a bunk bed, but I still have the supports if you wanted to restore the ability to sleep 4 total. I haven’t weighed this trailer since renovations, but I estimate it to weigh around 1300-1400 lbs. I pulled it with my 4 cylinder 1998 RAV4 and it did fine, so it can be pulled by just about anything.
~
Comes with a removable Jackery 1000W V2 solar generator, 2 100W portable solar panels, 30 ft solar extension cable, steel cable to secure the solar panels, SetPower 48 QT fridge & freezer, coupler lock, 2 parking boot locks, and 4 wheel chocks.
~
Renovations completed in 2025:
* Replaced carpet with linoleum floor for easier cleaning (I have carpet scraps I’ve been using as rugs inside)
* Redid the kitchen counter, cabinets,  table, and closet area with real wood.
* Built a drawer system to hold the fridge/freezer
* Installed new 6 gallon water tank and new water pump
* Installed Maxxair fan (also still has factory crank roof vent)
* Installed new wheels and bearings
* Installed dimmable LED lights
* Redid the electrical system
* Installed custom magnetic entry screen
* Made custom curtains and extra cushions
~
There is an old propane tank on the front, but it no longer runs into the camper because the new fridge is an efficient fully electric fridge and I removed the old cooktop to have more counter space. I used a camp stove with a butane canister on the counter when I needed to cook inside. It also came with the awning, but I only opened it one time because one of the end caps is broken and it makes it difficult to use.

title: Sol-Ark Limitless 15K-LV Hybrid Solar Inverter
description:
Sol-Ark Limitless 15K-LV Hybrid Inverter (15kW) – Like New

Power your home or off-grid setup with one of the most versatile inverters on the market.

🔋 Model: Sol-Ark Limitless 15K-LV
⚡ Output: 15,000W (15kW)
🔌 Voltage: 120/240V (also supports 120/208V & 220V)
🔄 Type: Hybrid inverter (grid-tied + off-grid + battery backup capable)

💡 What it does:
This is the “brain” of a solar power system. It converts DC power from solar panels or batteries into usable AC power for your home. It can also manage power between solar, batteries, generator, and the grid.

✅ Works with solar panels, batteries, generator, and utility power
✅ Built-in transfer switch (great for whole-home backup)
✅ Can run fully off-grid or grid-tied
✅ Expandable / stackable for larger systems
✅ High efficiency (~97%)

It will:
 • Convert solar → power your home
 • Send excess power back to the grid
 • Pull from the grid when solar isn’t enough
 • This is basically a standard grid-tied solar system with a hybrid inverter.

👉 In this setup, batteries are optional

Perfect for:
🏡 Whole-home backup systems
☀️ Solar installations
🔌 Off-grid cabins or shops
⚡ Energy independence setups

💲 Price: 4,000
📍 Located in PLEASANT GROVE
📩 Message me with questions or to schedule pickup

⸻

title: Polycarbonate Sheets - KIREX GP - Approx. 47" x 36" x 1/4" - Lexan-Style Panels
description:
For sale are heavy-duty KIREX GP Clear Polycarbonate sheets (36 sheets available). Much stronger and more impact-resistant than standard acrylic or plexiglass. All main panels have protective plastic film/masking on both sides, although some of the film is plain and does not have the KIREX printing (about 2/3 of the sheets have the KIREX printing). Some of the clear angled side supports/stands do not have protective masking.

Note: These are surplus KIREX GP general-purpose polycarbonate panels. I do not have the manufacturer UV rating, so I am selling them as project material rather than certified long-term exterior/greenhouse glazing. Yellowing or hazing is possible over time in direct sun, so they are not recommended as permanent greenhouse or sunroom glazing.

Dimensions: Approx. 47-1/16" x 36", not including the small hooks/tabs for the supports. These are nominal 1/4" / 6mm thick and measure about 0.218" with calipers.

Brand: KIREX GP, marked on the protective film on many panels. Korean-made polycarbonate, same general type of material as Lexan GP / Tuffak GP / Makrolon GP-style general purpose polycarbonate.

Original Use: Commercial countertop sneeze guards for reception desks and retail. Includes clear angled side supports/stands that hold the panels upright.

Perfect for DIY Projects: Because this is polycarbonate, Lexan-style, it is much less likely to crack or shatter than acrylic when drilled or cut. Can be cut to size with a circular saw, table saw, or jigsaw using the proper fine-tooth blade. Great for:

• Shed or playhouse windows
• Garden covers / cold frame projects
• Machine guards / shop safety shields
• Trailer or equipment windows
• Chicken coop protection
• Desktop protectors or signage

Condition: Surplus/industrial grade. Expect some dust, light edge scuffs, or storage marks. Sold as-is. Perfect for project material.

Pricing:

• $45 each
• $40 each for 3+
• $35 each for 5+
• $30 each for 10+

Cash only. Please bring a vehicle that can fit 4-foot panels flat!
